## Open-Source and Low-Resource Guardrails
Reference: `docs/OPEN_SOURCE_GUARDRAIL_CHECKLIST.md`

- [ ] Offline-first behavior preserved (no internet required for core flows).
- [ ] Local-first data guarantees preserved.
- [ ] No mandatory cloud/proprietary dependency added.
- [ ] Performance impact reviewed for older/constrained hardware.
- [ ] Data/query path impact reviewed (indexes/bounds where needed).
- [ ] License compatibility of added dependencies reviewed.
- [ ] Changelog + sprint docs updated chronologically with UTC date.
- [ ] Public release guardrail scan run or scope exception documented.
